responsibility: Provides the x86 AMX-FP8 intrinsic interface for FP8 tile matrix multiply-accumulate operations. This header defines the tile dot-product instruction wrappers for BF8/HF8 combinations such as `_tile_dpbf8ps`, `_tile_dpbhf8ps`, `_tile_dphbf8ps`, and `_tile_dphf8ps`, using inline assembly on x86_64 to expose AMX FP8 arithmetic through GCC’s intrinsic layer.
